PowerShell(Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "node|claude|python" } | Select-Object Id, Name, StartTime, @{N='RuntimeMin';E={[int]\(\(Get-Date\) - $_.StartTime\).TotalMinutes}} | Sort-Object StartTime)

PowerShell(Get-Process -Id 8716 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, Name, StartTime, Responding, @{N='CPUSeconds';E={[int]$_.CPU}}; Write-Output "---"; Get-WmiObject Win32_Process -Filter "ParentProcessId=8716" 2>$null | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CommandLine)

PowerShell(Get-WmiObject Win32_Process -Filter "ParentProcessId=17104" 2>$null | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CommandLine, @{N='CPU';E={\(Get-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).CPU}}; Write-Output "---children-of-17104"; Get-Process -Id 17104 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, Responding, @{N='CPUSec';E={[int]$_.CPU}}, StartTime)

PowerShell(Get-WmiObject Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match "claude|node" -and $_.CommandLine -notmatch "fleet|extension" } 2>$null | Select-Object ProcessId, ParentProcessId, Name, @{N='Cmd';E={$_.CommandLine.Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(120,$_.CommandLine.Length\)\)}}; Write-Output "---"; Get-Process -Id 17104 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, Responding, @{N='CPUSec';E={[int]$_.CPU}}, @{N='MemMB';E={[int]\($_.WorkingSet64/1MB\)}}, StartTime)

PowerShell(Get-Process -Id 17104 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-List Id, Name, StartTime, Responding, CPU, WorkingSet64; Write-Output "---all-claude-procs---"; Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "claude" } | Select-Object Id, Name, StartTime; Write-Output "---all-node-procs---"; Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "node" } | Select-Object Id, Name, StartTime, @{N='Path';E={$_.Path}})
